summary: AGNT, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion on September 14, 2026 of a previously disclosed repurchase of 8,693,290 common shares from Frank Selden, trustee of the Gratitude 2022 Trust, for an aggregate $31,991,307.20, implying roughly $3.68 per share. The block was bought at a 10% discount to the 5-day volume-weighted average price to meet the trust's time-sensitive tax and estate administration needs after trustee Penny Sanford's death. The independent Audit Committee unanimously approved the related-person transaction, stating it accelerates the capital return program beyond open-market purchases. Watch execution versus the remaining buyback authorization and any overhang from the trust.
